# Temperature String Parser

An x86 MASM program that allows users to input the name of a .txt file containing a list of positive and negative temperature values. The values are parsed by the program and printed in reverse order as numeric values, not ASCII characters.

## Project Details

* `Proj6_bishopdy.asm` - The main project code for the program operations
* `Temps090124.txt` - Sample text file provided by OSU
* `Project.sln` & `Project.vcxproj` & `Project.lst` - Files for use and generated by Visual Studio

## Requirements

* Windows (32-bit or 64-bit)
* Visual Studio (with modules for MASM support)
* Irvine Library

## Usage

* Double click the 'Project.sln' file to open with Visual Studio
* Keep desired .txt file in the same directory as the project file
* Start without Debugging in Visual Studio

## Acknowledgements

Skeleton code and project design provided by Oregon State University's Computer Architecture and Assembly Language (CS 271) class.
